requirements.title: CFI_section has the ISO_Fortran_binding.h array-section interface
requirements.definition: CFI_section has the interface int CFI_section(CFI_cdesc_t *result, const CFI_cdesc_t *source, const CFI_index_t lower_bounds[], const CFI_index_t upper_bounds[], const CFI_index_t strides[]) and updates a descriptor for an array section.

pending.CFI_section-interface: C companion includes ISO_Fortran_binding.h, declares result and source CFI_cdesc_t pointers plus lower, upper, and stride arrays, and compiles an ordinary CFI_section call returning int.

requirements.title: CFI_section actual arguments must satisfy result, source, bounds, and stride restrictions
requirements.definition: The result descriptor rank and attribute, source descriptor state, matching element length and type, lower-bound array, upper-bound array, and stride array shall satisfy the stated restrictions, including assumed-size upper bounds and in-bounds lower and upper values for selected dimensions.

pending.CFI_section-result-descriptor-restrictio: Positive companion establishes result descriptors with CFI_attribute_other and ranks two and one for nonzero and zero-stride cases; attribute mutation remains a nonconforming no-diagnostic negative.
pending.CFI_section-source-descriptor-restrictio: Source companion uses an established nonallocatable nonpointer rank-two int descriptor; unallocated source mutation is nonconforming and no portable diagnostic is required.
pending.CFI_section-lower-bound-restrictions: Use lower {1,0} for the strided rank-two section and lower {0,2} for the rank-reducing section, both within source descriptor bounds before calling CFI_section.
pending.CFI_section-upper-bound-restrictions: Use upper {3,4} for the strided rank-two section and upper {3,2} for the rank-reducing section; assumed-size source coverage is deferred to a Fortran-provided descriptor positive control.
pending.CFI_section-stride-array-restrictions: Use strides {2,2} for an ordinary section and {1,0} for rank reduction; null stride companion exercises the default stride-one path.

requirements.title: Successful CFI_section describes the Fortran-equivalent section with defaulted bounds and strides
requirements.definition: Successful CFI_section updates result base_addr and dim members to describe the section equivalent to SOURCE(sectsub1,...), using source lower and upper bounds for null arrays, stride one for null strides, and a scalar subscript for each zero stride whose lower and upper values are equal.

pending.CFI_section-updates-base-and-dim: C companion fills a 4 by 5 int source with value 100*i+j in descriptor subscript coordinates, calls CFI_section with lower {1,0}, upper {3,4}, strides {2,2}, and asserts result base_addr plus dim strides select exactly values 100, 300, 102, 302, 104, and 304 in column-major descriptor order.
pending.CFI_section-fortran-section-equivalence: The same expected values are hand-derived from SOURCE(1:3:2,0:4:2): first dimension values 1 and 3, second dimension values 0, 2, and 4, giving descriptor order (1,0), (3,0), (1,2), (3,2), (1,4), (3,4) and values 100, 300, 102, 302, 104, and 304.
pending.CFI_section-null-bound-and-stride-defaul: A full-section companion passes null lower_bounds, null upper_bounds, and null strides; it asserts result extents match source extents 4 and 5 and CFI_address for {0,0} and {3,4} reaches the source endpoint values.
pending.CFI_section-zero-stride-rank-reduction: Rank-one result companion passes lower {0,2}, upper {3,2}, strides {1,0}; it asserts result extent 4 and values 2, 102, 202, and 302, proving the second dimension is fixed at subscript 2.

requirements.title: Detected CFI_section errors preserve the result descriptor
requirements.definition: After a detected CFI_section error, the result descriptor is not modified.

pending.CFI_section-detected-error-preserves-res: C companion establishes a valid rank-one int source descriptor with bounds 0:2 and a valid result descriptor, snapshots result base_addr, elem_len, version, rank, attribute, type, and every dim lower_bound, extent, and sm member, calls CFI_section with lower_bounds {-1}, upper_bounds {0}, and strides {1}, and asserts the returned indicator is CFI_ERROR_OUT_OF_BOUNDS from the lower bound outside the source bounds plus every snapshotted result member is unchanged.
